result:
**I'd make curiosity the default human operating system.**

Not forced education, not mandatory "critical thinking" classes—actual, bone-deep *wonder*. The kind that makes people allergic to lazy answers, hungry for reality, and genuinely excited to be wrong because it means they get to update their model of the universe.

If that single trait became as natural as breathing, most of our worst problems would become solvable almost as side effects: tribalism, dogma, environmental destruction, bullshit politics, even a lot of personal misery. People who are truly curious don't need to be lectured about empathy or long-term thinking; they arrive there naturally while chasing what’s real.

Everything else—fusion power, space colonization, biological immortality, fixing governance—becomes an engineering problem instead of a human nature problem.

One switch. Maximum leverage.
